description: VMap1 Airport Control Towers is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency. This datalayer is a point coverage representing control towers and airport lighting features throughout current VMap1 geographic coverage areas. Features in this layer have a FACC (Feature and Attribute Coding Catalogue) Codes of GB010, defined as, "Airport Lighting. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For educational, non-commercial use only. Although this data set has been developed by the NGA no warranty expressed or implied is made by them as to. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
